solarReturn.title: Your solar return
solarReturn.body: A year around the sun today — begin a new personal year in step with it?

seasonClosing.title: A season is closing
seasonClosing.body: “{title}” is drawing to a close — reflect and close it?

newMoon.title: A new moon
newMoon.body: New moon {when} — set an intention to carry through the month?

fullMoon.title: A full moon
fullMoon.body: Full moon {when} — what has grown, and what's ready to release?

seasonTurning.title: A season is turning
seasonTurning.body: The {turningPoint} is {when} — {season} begins. Begin a personal season in step with it?

body.menstrual: A time to rest and let go — what wants to be released?
body.follicular: Energy is returning — what would you like to begin?
body.ovulation: A brighter, outward stretch — what are you ready to share?
body.luteal: A time to complete and tend — what deserves closing well?

body.one: {count} note is waiting in the Inbox — sort it into place?
body.other: {count} notes are waiting in the Inbox — sort them into place?

synthesizeWisdom.title: A thread to weave
synthesizeWisdom.body: You've kept a few ideas about “{theme}” — weave them into one?

promoteIdentity.title: Becoming true
promoteIdentity.body: “{title}” has been with you a while — is it becoming true?
